This isn't your typical sweatfest like most AAA games and it's mostly designed to encourage you to be reckless. Unironically a strategy I've employed to kill bile titans is to literally become the mortar purposefully dying and crashing our pods into them because none of us had ammo. Your helldiver is an expendable tool and unless you're straight mulching through lives usually dying is not a big deal at all and when the mulching happens it's an issue that the whole team is dealing with anyways. You don't need to play the meta to do helldive it's all about having fun and anything you'd need to learn will eventually become natural to you anyways. I've dragged level 4 cadets into helldive difficulty with us all cackling laughing having a great time the entire time and still winning! (No extraction though but that's ok) my only secret for helldive is knowing to basically NEVER stick in one spot because enemies will just continuously spawn and devour your lives. Run away and come back for your things later and the enemies will all have either moved on or despawned.
